name: circuits
definition: 举办赛车比赛的固定场地设施，具有名称、所在地理位置与经纬度坐标等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「比赛场次(races)」混淆：赛道是物理场地，比赛场次是在该场地上于特定时间举行的一次赛事。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table circuits; provenance: direct source circuits

name: constructors
definition: 以组织身份报名参赛并制造或运营赛车的实体，具有名称与国籍等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车手(drivers)」混淆：车队是组织实体，车手是自然人参赛者。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table constructors; provenance: direct source constructors

name: races
definition: 在特定赛道于特定日期举行的一轮赛事活动，具有年份、轮次与举办日期等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「赛道(circuits)」混淆：比赛场次是时间上发生的事件，赛道是承载该事件的物理场地。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table races; provenance: direct source races

name: constructorResults
definition: 记录某车队在某场比赛中获得积分与状态的成绩条目，具有积分与状态等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车队积分榜(constructorStandings)」混淆：前者是单场成绩记录，后者是赛季累计排名。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table constructorResults; provenance: direct source constructorResults

name: constructorStandings
definition: 记录某车队在某场比赛后累计积分与排名的榜单条目，具有累计积分、名次与胜场数等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车队比赛成绩(constructorResults)」混淆：前者是累计排名，后者是单场得分。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table constructorStandings; provenance: direct source constructorStandings

name: drivers
definition: 以自然人身份参加赛车比赛的参赛者，具有姓名、出生日期与国籍等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车队(constructors)」混淆：车手是自然人，车队是组织。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table drivers; provenance: direct source drivers

name: results
definition: 记录某车手驾驶某车队赛车在某场比赛中发车、完赛与得分情况的成绩条目，具有发车位、名次与积分等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车队比赛成绩(constructorResults)」混淆：前者以车手为主体，后者以车队为主体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table results; provenance: direct source results

name: driverStandings
definition: 记录某车手在某场比赛后累计积分与排名的榜单条目，具有累计积分、名次与胜场数等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车手比赛成绩(results)」混淆：前者是累计排名，后者是单场成绩。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table driverStandings; provenance: direct source driverStandings

name: status
definition: 描述比赛结果所处情形的分类条目，具有状态名称等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「比赛场次(races)」混淆：状态是结果分类的字典条目，不是赛事活动本身。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table status; provenance: direct source status

name: seasons
definition: 以年份标识的一整个比赛周期，具有年份等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「比赛场次(races)」混淆：赛季是跨多场比赛的时间周期，比赛场次是其中单轮赛事。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table seasons; provenance: direct source seasons

name: lapTimes
definition: 记录某车手在某场比赛中某一圈所用时间与排位的计时条目，具有圈号与用时等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「进站记录(pitStops)」混淆：前者记录每圈行驶用时，后者记录进站停靠事件。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table lapTimes; provenance: direct source lapTimes

name: pitStops
definition: 记录某车手在某场比赛中进站停靠的事件，具有停靠次序、发生圈号与停留时长等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「单圈计时(lapTimes)」混淆：进站记录是维修区停靠事件，单圈计时是赛道行驶用时。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table pitStops; provenance: direct source pitStops

name: qualifying
definition: 记录某车手在某场比赛排位阶段各节成绩与名次的条目，具有第一节、第二节、第三节用时等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车手比赛成绩(results)」混淆：前者决定发车顺序，后者记录正赛结果。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table qualifying; provenance: direct source qualifying

name: Driver
definition: A Formula 1 driver identified by full name (forename + surname) or driverRef.

name: Constructor
definition: A Formula 1 team/constructor.

name: Race
definition: A Formula 1 Grand Prix event, identified by raceId or name.

name: Circuit
definition: A racing circuit with location and coordinates.

name: RaceResult
definition: A driver's result in a specific race, including position, points, time, laps.

name: ConstructorResult
definition: Points scored by a constructor in a race.

name: DriverStanding
definition: Cumulative driver championship standings after a race.

name: ConstructorStanding
definition: Cumulative constructor championship standings after a race.

name: Qualifying
definition: Qualifying session results for a driver in a race.

name: LapTime
definition: Lap-by-lap timing data for drivers in a race.

name: PitStop
definition: Pit stop events with duration for each driver in a race.

name: Status
definition: The finishing status of a driver in a race (e.g., finished, accident, mechanical failure).

name: Accident
definition: A race result where the driver's status indicates an accident.

name: FinishedRace
definition: A race result where the driver completed the race (time is not null).
scope: results where time IS NOT NULL

name: NotFinishedRace
definition: A race result where the driver did not finish (time is null).

name: DriverNationality
definition: The nationality of a driver.

name: ConstructorNationality
definition: The nationality of a constructor.

name: DriverDOB
definition: Driver's date of birth.

name: CircuitCoordinates
definition: Latitude and longitude of a circuit.

name: CircuitCountry
definition: Country where a circuit is located.

name: RaceYear
definition: The year a race took place.

name: RaceDate
definition: The date a race took place.

name: DriverRef
definition: Short reference name for a driver.

name: ConstructorURL
definition: Website URL for a constructor.

name: DriverURL
definition: Website URL for a driver.

name: AccidentCount
definition: Total number of accidents for a driver. Formula: COUNT(Accident.resultId). Inputs: Accident = results.resultId WHERE statusId = 3

name: AveragePitStopDuration
definition: Average pit stop duration for a driver. Formula: AVG(PitStop.milliseconds). Inputs: PitStop = pitStops.milliseconds

name: FastestLapSpeed
definition: Maximum lap speed recorded in a race. Formula: MAX(LapTime.fastestLapSpeed). Inputs: LapTime = lapTimes.milliseconds

name: ChampionFinishTime
definition: Finish time of the race winner. Formula: MIN(RaceResult.time) WHERE position = 1. Inputs: RaceResult = results.resultId

name: LastDriverFinishTime
definition: Finish time of the last finishing driver. Formula: MAX(RaceResult.time) WHERE time IS NOT NULL. Inputs: RaceResult = results.resultId

name: PercentageNotFirstTrack
definition: Percentage of races where a driver did not finish in first position. Formula: COUNT(RaceResult WHERE position > 1) / COUNT(RaceResult) * 100. Inputs: RaceResult = results.resultId

name: MaxConstructorPoints
definition: Maximum points scored by a constructor in a race. Formula: MAX(ConstructorResult.points). Inputs: ConstructorResult = constructorResults.points

name: MaxDriverPoints
definition: Maximum points scored by a driver in a race. Formula: MAX(RaceResult.points). Inputs: RaceResult = results.resultId

name: DriverAge
definition: Age of a driver at a given time. Formula: DATEDIFF(RaceDate, DriverDOB). Inputs: RaceDate = races.date; DriverDOB = drivers.dob

name: RaceCount
definition: Number of races a driver participated in. Formula: COUNT(RaceResult.raceId). Inputs: RaceResult = results.resultId

name: CircuitHeldCount
definition: Number of times a circuit hosted a race. Formula: COUNT(Race.raceId). Inputs: Race = races.raceId
aliases: how many times circuits were held
